findings.text: The image minus state column reads +0.0000 mWb on all 31 upper-half-plane promoted nodes (image_wb - state_wb about 1.9e-10 Wb) while the 29 lower-half-plane nodes read -4.6e-03 to -2.6e-02 Wb, and this sentence concludes that the column 'measures geometry rather than an instrument gap'; the reviewed run's own manifest records that same asymmetry as unresolved ('every upper-halfplane node reads 0.0000 mWb while the lower-halfplane nodes read -2 to -26 mWb ... the per-node column should be checked before it is used node by node'), so the fragment presents a column half of which is an unexplained null as a whole one.

The '0.5 mm' scale-bar label is drawn at centre[1] - 0.86*half under the dashed converged-state separatrix plotted across the zoom panel at line 193, and the PNG rendered from the committed fields shows the dashed line running through the text; _assert_text_inside at lines 44-62 tests text against text and the canvas only, so the rule that refuses a direct label sitting over plotted data is not enforced.

The gate the manifest names ran at SOURCE_REVISION cf3607fe3 and its render step logged a 73341-byte SVG and zoom_window_mm 40.0, while the committed panel is 72139 bytes with a 3.0 mm window and was produced by commits d09bc14d7 and 2e7bbb056 made after the gate ended, so the recorded gate does not cover the reviewed head; the committed SVG is nevertheless byte-identical to a fresh render from the gate's own measure-5-fields.npz and the fragment is exactly compose(measure-5.json), so the artifact is reproducible even though the gate did not produce it.
